colour.reasoning: The undertone notes are consistently warm: the skin is golden-brown with honey tones, the shadows under the jaw stay warm brown rather than ashy, and the skin keeps its golden cast next to the magenta. The silver jewellery reads as a separate cool contrast rather than blending in. The very slight cool-neutral cast is negligible, so this warmth is not caused by the lighting. Medium skin with very deep black-brown hair and dark brown eyes gives the reported high contrast, and the fully saturated magenta (#C2226E) beside black trousers sits well rather than overpowering her, which points to clear rather than muted. Warm, clear and high contrast makes her a bright spring rather than an autumn, with deep autumn as the nearest alternative.

skin.undertone_evidence: Skin reads golden-brown in soft daylight, with warm honey tones on the forehead, cheeks and hands. Shadows under the jaw and at the neck stay warm brown, not grey or ashy. Beside the bright magenta blouse the skin keeps its golden cast. She wears silver jewellery (hoops, chain, rings), which sits as a clear cool contrast and does not blend into the skin. Lips are a natural rosy-brown.

colour.intro: You are a bright spring: warm, high in contrast and clear. Your strong dark hair, defined brows and dark eyes sit against golden skin, so colour has to match that strength. Clarity is your must. Every shade needs to be clean and vivid, because anything dusty, smoky or greyed will look tired beside your features. Undertone is where you can bend. Your saturation is strong enough to carry cooler brights like magenta, fuchsia and royal blue without losing your golden glow. If a colour is clear, it can lean slightly cool.
colour.how_to_combine: Put your brightest colour at the neckline, as you do with magenta. Keep ink navy, camel, warm ivory, warm stone and black below the face, where they work as the base. Use ivory instead of chalk white. The flow colours, magenta, deep teal, rust orange and peach, join in as accents or tops, as long as each stays saturated.

line.face_intro: Your face is oval, with a soft tapered jaw, rounded cheekbones and a neck of moderate length. Your brows and cheekbones lead. Most necklines work, so the aim is to show your neck and keep the line clean. Open collars and shallow V-necks do that, and scoops echo your cheekbones. Your long waves already balance your chin. If you add frames, choose a soft lift at the outer corner in a warm honey tone.
line.body_intro: You have a slight, balanced frame at average height. Your shoulders and hips are even, and your legs are longer than your torso. That is why high-waisted wide-leg trousers work so well on you. Tuck the top at your natural waist and let the leg run full length, so the line stays long. Keep volume in one half of the outfit and fit the other half close. Knee-to-mid-calf kurtas and fluid drapes with a fitted blouse use the same logic.

style.what_you_wear: In your photo, the magenta blouse is doing the most. Saturated colour at your face keeps your golden skin warm and suits your high contrast. The black wide-leg trousers sit at your natural waist with a clean crease, and the tuck makes your legs look longer. The pointed boots extend that line. The silver jewellery is the only thing working against you.
style.what_it_says: This outfit says you are relaxed but sharp. The soft sheen and full leg read easy, while the crease, the tuck and the pointed toe read considered. That is Polished Ease. You look like someone who dresses with intent and does not need to make a fuss about it.
style.the_words: Your three words are fluid, polished and bright. Use them as a filter when you shop. Does it move? Is it pressed, tucked or finished? Is the colour clear? If an item misses one of the three, leave it. If it misses two, it is not for you. In your heat, check the fabric breathes too.

report.buy_intro: Buy in the order shown. Priority one unlocks the most outfits, so start there. Each card has search terms you can paste into a shop, and a note on which outfits it unlocks. The budget tiers sit inside your 1,500 to 4,000 range, so work down the list as you can.
report.grooming_intro: Your grooming is mostly right already. Your hair, brows and skin finish stay. The changes are small: a bright lip to match the strength of your hair and brows, and a lighter finish for humid days. Jewellery also moves to gold.
report.closing: Remember this: clear colour at your face, gold on your skin, and a tucked top over a wide leg. This week, buy small shiny gold hoops. Wear them with your magenta blouse and black wide-leg trousers to the office. That one swap warms everything you already own.

filters: Keep clear, saturated brights like fuchsia and coral near your face.
Default to ink navy, not black, for suits and dresses.
Choose yellow gold jewellery and hardware; leave silver behind.
Tuck the top, widen the trouser: volume in one half only.
Ask: is it fluid, polished and bright? If not, skip.

verification.claim: Saturated colour near your face is your strongest move
High-waisted wide-leg trousers suit your proportions
Your hair frames your face beautifully

Swap the Your silver hoops, chain and stacked rings (worn in the photo) for Shiny yellow-gold or gold-plated small hoops, a fine gold chain at the collarbone and two or three slim gold rings, each easy to find within 1,500 to 4,000.
